sloka: स गृध्र राजः कृतवान् यशस्करम्सु दुष्करम् कर्म रणे निपातितः ।महर्षि कल्पेन च संस्कृतः तदाजगाम पुण्याम् गतिम् आत्मनः शुभाम् ॥३-६८-३७॥
transliteration: sa gṛdhra rājaḥ kṛtavān yaśaskaramsu duṣkaram karma raṇe nipātitaḥ ।maharṣi kalpena ca saṁskṛtaḥ tadājagāma puṇyām gatim ātmanaḥ śubhām ॥3-68-37॥

translations.english: The king of vultures had performed a very difficult and glorious feat by laying down his life fighting. Sanctified by Rama's offering as laid down in scriptures by the seers, he attained a holy, auspicious and divine state of the self.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र तो अपनी धीरता और बोरता से दुःखी न हुए, परन्तु लक्ष्मण बालक होने के कारण, पकड़े जाने पर घबड़ा गये
